one-page.hypothesis: Lower shared-memory use can admit more resident blocks; loses double-buffer prefetch.

group-slack2.hypothesis: Coarser aligned leaf groups reduce workspace and fold traffic, at the cost of fewer blocks.

group-slack8.hypothesis: Finer aligned leaf groups expose more parallelism, at the cost of workspace and fold traffic.

body-tiles.hypothesis: Count actual packed-body tiles when choosing group size, reducing unnecessary split workspace.

packed64.hypothesis: A shorter packed tile reduces per-thread register demand and increases the number of independent blocks.
